kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the section's table and cascade diagrams.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid supplies the table and the diagrams; the attack structure is a KYP design.

kypExtensions.summary: The class-summary compression of the page's own two elements (table + diagrams) into the THREE LANES reading: LANE 1 — Gs THE GAS PEDAL (receptor → Gs protein → adenylyl cyclase ON → ATP → ↑cAMP → protein kinase A), membership the diagram's own chip list (β1, β2, β3, D1, H2, V2); LANE 2 — Gi THE BRAKE (receptor → Gi protein → adenylyl cyclase OFF → ↓cAMP), membership (α2, M2, D2); LANE 3 — Gq THE SQUEEZE (receptor → Gq protein → phospholipase C → PIP2 → IP3 + DAG → Ca2+ + protein kinase C → smooth muscle contraction via myosin light-chain kinase), membership (α1, M1, M3, H1, V1). The reading order (NAME THE RECEPTOR → READ THE CLASS LETTER → RUN THE LANE) and the gas-pedal/brake/squeeze naming are KYP's; every lane's steps and membership list are the page's own prints.
kypExtensions.rationale: The book prints the table and the three diagrams as separate elements; the unified lane reading, the gas/brake/squeeze compression, and the reading protocol are KYP's synthesis — every cascade step and chip is the page's own.
kypExtensions.location: core.keyIdea + mechanisms + the visual's cascade panels

kypExtensions.summary: The membership memory layer: THE i CLASS IS ALL 2s (α2, D2, M2 — the only three subscript-2 receptors in Gi) with its shadow warning NOT ALL 2s ARE Gi (β2, H2, V2 are Gs — the three 2s that got away); THE q CLASS IS THE ODD ONES (α1, M1, M3, H1, V1 — all the 1s plus M3); THE s CLASS IS THE BETAS PLUS THE STRAYS (β1, β2, β3, D1, H2, V2). The subscript frames are KYP compressions of the table's own 14 letters; the odd/even muscarinic rule (M1/M3 odd = Gq, M2 even = Gi) was already carried as a KYP extension by PH12 and resolves HERE into the book's own q/i/q letters.
kypExtensions.rationale: The table prints the letters but never comments on the subscript pattern; the membership frames, the not-all-2s warning, and the odd/even rule are KYP's design.
kypExtensions.location: usmle.traps + mnemonics + the visual's codes strip

kypExtensions.summary: The clinical/drug anchor layer (NONE of it printed on this page, flagged wherever it appears): albuterol β2-Gs (bronchodilation), dobutamine β1-Gs (inotropy), clonidine α2-Gi (↓ sympathetic outflow), phenylephrine α1-Gq (vasoconstriction/mydriasis), atropine M3-Gq blockade (the glands/secrets story), cimetidine H2-Gs blockade (↓ gastric acid), desmopressin V2-Gs (aquaporin-2), the D2-Gi antipsychotic story (the table's own striatum strings), pertussis toxin (ADP-ribosylates Gi — the whooping-cough anchor) and cholera toxin (ADP-ribosylates Gs — the secretory-diarrhea anchor). Plus the two KYP forks: the KINASE FORK (Gs → PKA vs Gq → PKC — never swap them) and the PIP2 SPLITTER (one phospholipid, two messengers: IP3 frees Ca2+, DAG holds PKC), and the vagal M2 βγ-subunit K+ -channel story (beyond the printed diagram, flagged).
kypExtensions.rationale: The page prints no drug names and no toxins; the anchors, the kinase fork, the PIP2-splitter frame, and the βγ K+ -channel story are KYP layers built on the page's own cascades.
kypExtensions.location: usmle + crossLinks + mnemonics clinical + the visual's anchor strip

notes: Census (pdfimages + text layer + VLM render check): the G-protein–linked second messengers section occupies the WHOLE of pdf 259 (book 237) under the standing 'PHARMACOLOGY—AUTONOMIC DRUGS' banner — the only section header on the page. The section prints TWO elements: (1) ONE TABLE — 14 receptor rows under RECEPTOR / G-PROTEIN CLASS / MAJOR FUNCTIONS, grouped Adrenergic (α1 q, α2 i, β1 s, β2 s, β3 s), Cholinergic (M1 q, M2 i, M3 q), Dopamine (D1 s, D2 i), Histamine (H1 q, H2 s), Vasopressin (V1 q, V2 s); (2) THREE VECTOR CASCADE DIAGRAMS (Gq, Gs, Gi) whose labels print in the text layer (receptor chips 'H1, α1, V1, M1, or M3 receptor' / 'B1, B2, B3, D1, H2, or V2 receptor' / 'M2, α2, or D2 receptor'; transducers Gq/GS/Gi protein; enzymes phospholipase C / adenylyl cyclase; PIP2 → IP3 + DAG → Ca2+ + protein kinase C; ATP → cyclic AMP → protein kinase A; smooth muscle contraction + myosin light-chain kinase). RASTER CENSUS: ZERO raster images on pdf 259 (pdfimages -list returns no rows) — the diagrams are vector typeset artwork, COPYRIGHTED, never reproduced; conveyed as ONE original KYP schematic (GProteinSecondMessengerMap) and the table carried VERBATIM as the note's table block. TEXT-LAYER ARTIFACTS pinned: the V2 row prints the book's own red-ink erratum overlay 'collecting twobules (tubules)' (VLM render check confirms the printed page); the diagram text layer duplicates every label (two-layer artwork) and prints 'B1, B2, B3' where the table prints real β glyphs; the interleaving of diagram labels splits the V2 row in extraction (both fragments quoted). SECTION EXTENT verified: the section ENDS at the pdf 259 footer; pdf 260 (book 238) opens the SEPARATE pending 'Autonomic drugs' section — sourcePages = [259] only. BOUNDARIES: pdf 258 carries the COMPLETED PH14 (upper) and PH15 (lower) — EXCLUDED; PH12 'acetylcholine-receptors' anchored its M1/M2/M3 G-protein layer to THIS page (the reciprocal cross-link pinned). KYP extensions flagged wherever they appear: the three-lanes reading (gas pedal / brake / squeeze), the subscript-rule membership frames (the i class is all 2s; not all 2s are Gi), the drug/toxin anchor layer (albuterol, dobutamine, clonidine, phenylephrine, atropine, cimetidine, desmopressin, antipsychotics, pertussis toxin, cholera toxin — none printed), the kinase fork (PKA vs PKC), the PIP2-splitter frame, and the M2 βγ K+ -channel story. The classic 'one heart, two lungs' counting code is THIS page's own print — '(one heart)' and '(two lungs)' in the β1/β2 rows — carried verbatim and attributed (PH15's facing-page attribution resolves here). No copyrighted artwork reproduced; nothing reproduced.
